metadata.title: The effect of unbound stars on the mass modelling of the Fornax dwarf

notes: The paper analyzes an aggregate kinematic sample of 202 Fornax stars and does not supply individual star identifiers (T:p1-b6; Figure 1, I:p2-b0–I:p2-b3). Its “unbound” stars are described as stars stripped from Fornax or as Milky Way contaminants (T:p1-b5; T:p5-b5; T:p6-b2), not as stars unbound from the Milky Way. No individual star is identified or retained as a Galactic unbound candidate, so no star meets the eligibility criteria.
